title: High Expressive Ratio / tension diagrams
slide_intent: Explain a small set of compositional changes because controlled variation makes a system easier to reuse.
strategic_value: Position and scale shifts can give Dropbox’s paired planes variety without abandoning their common seam.
demonstration: Six blue-and-gray diagrams compare aligned rectangles, positional shifts and scale shifts in landscape and portrait arrangements; orange lines emphasize the seams.
practical_value: Choose whether contrast comes from alignment, displacement or unequal scale.

content_islands.name: Landscape row
content_islands.spec: Arrange three side-by-side pairings across the top with labels below.

content_islands.name: Portrait row
content_islands.spec: Stack the paired planes across the lower row and retain their labels.

content_islands.name: Seam annotations
content_islands.spec: Use orange strokes and the central tension annotation to identify the shared boundaries.
